name: Absorption Flow P1 scatter submits exact original work to Free Cities

condition.code:
local plan=Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER')
if not plan or not plan.ID or not plan.WorkIndex then return false end
local carrier=CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.X,plan.Y)
local source=CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.Work.X,plan.Work.Y)
local human=CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.Recovery.X,plan.Recovery.Y)
return carrier and carrier:GetOwner()==plan.Free and carrier:GetID()==plan.ID
 and carrier:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Building,plan.Slot)==-1
 and source and source:GetOwner()==plan.Work.Owner
 and source:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Work.Building,plan.Work.Slot)==plan.WorkIndex
 and human and human:GetOwner()==plan.Recovery.Owner
 and human:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Recovery.Building,plan.Recovery.Slot)==-1

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local F=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlowGameplay)
local carrier=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER'))
local previous=assert(A.GetState().Transactions['native-product-return-probe'])
assert(previous.Status=='COMPLETE' and carrier.Free==62 and carrier.WorkIndex==2,'prior product result or carrier missing')
local locations=A.NativeWorkLocations(carrier.WorkIndex)
assert(#locations==1 and A.Rules.Equal(locations[1],carrier.Work),'original third-party work changed before scatter')
local reads=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_HeroReadAPI)
local freeSlots=reads.FindCompatibleNativeSlots(carrier.Free,carrier.Work.ObjectType)
local humanSlots=reads.FindCompatibleNativeSlots(1,carrier.Work.ObjectType)
assert(#freeSlots==1 and freeSlots[1].Owner==carrier.Free and freeSlots[1].City==carrier.ID
 and freeSlots[1].X==carrier.X and freeSlots[1].Y==carrier.Y
 and freeSlots[1].Building==carrier.Building and freeSlots[1].Slot==carrier.Slot,'Free Cities reserved Temple changed')
assert(#humanSlots==1 and A.Rules.Equal(humanSlots[1],carrier.Recovery),'human recovery Temple changed')
local working=assert(DealManager.GetWorkingDeal(DealDirection.OUTGOING,carrier.Work.Owner,carrier.Free))
assert(working:GetItemCount()==0,'unrelated AI-to-Free Cities working deal exists')
local items=DealManager.GetPossibleDealItems(carrier.Work.Owner,carrier.Free,DealItemTypes.GREATWORK,working)
local available
for _,item in ipairs(items or {}) do if item.ForType==carrier.WorkIndex then available=item end end
assert(available and available.IsValid,'AI donor to Free Cities original work is not a valid Core deal item')
local plan={ID='native-scatter-flow',From=carrier.Work.Owner,To=1,Mode='MERGER',EntryConditionsMet=true,RelationsResolved=true}
Game:SetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_FLOW_TEST_MODE',1)
local ids={['leader:'..plan.From]=true}
for id in pairs(A.GetRoster(plan.From)) do ids[id]=true end
for _,unit in Players[plan.From]:GetUnits():Members() do
 local person=unit:GetProperty(A.Rules.PERSON_KEY)
 local snap=A.SnapshotUnit(unit)
 local id=person and person.ID or snap.Kind=='UNIT' and ('unit:'..plan.From..':'..unit:GetID()) or ('native-person:'..plan.From..':'..unit:GetID())
 ids[id]=true
end
for _,work in ipairs(A.OwnedGreatWorkSlots(plan.From)) do ids['native-work:'..work.Index]=true end
for id in pairs(ids) do F.DebugSetRoll(plan.ID,id,'P1_ESCAPE',9999) end
F.DebugSetRoll(plan.ID,'native-work:'..carrier.WorkIndex,'P1_ESCAPE',0)
F.DebugSetRoll(plan.ID,'native-work:'..carrier.WorkIndex,'P1_BRANCH',0)
local flow=F.Begin(plan)
assert(flow.Phase=='CHOICE' and flow.Phase1Complete,'scatter Flow did not save phase one')
local scattered,count=nil,0
for _,entry in ipairs(flow.Entries or {}) do
 if entry.NativeWork and entry.NativeWork.Index==carrier.WorkIndex then scattered=entry;count=count+1 end
 if not entry.EscapeOutcome then F.DebugSetRoll(plan.ID,entry.ID,'P3_SUCCESS',0) end
end
assert(count==1 and scattered.EscapeOutcome=='SCATTER' and scattered.NativeWork.Index==carrier.WorkIndex,'original work did not scatter exactly once in P1')
local baseline={ID=plan.ID,From=plan.From,To=plan.To,WorkIndex=carrier.WorkIndex,Free=carrier.Free,FreeSlot=freeSlots[1],HumanSlot=humanSlots[1],Source=carrier.Work,Rolls=scattered.Rolls}
Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_SCATTER_FLOW',baseline)
print('[JAC_NATIVE_SCATTER_P1] '..A.Canonical(baseline))
return 'P1 scattered the original native work; other assets remain for UI choice'

condition.code: return JAC_AbsorptionFlow_UI~=nil and not Controls.OpenButton:IsHidden() and ExposedMembers.JAC_AbsorptionFlow.GetPending(Game.GetLocalPlayer())~=nil

steps.code:
local panel=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlow_UI)
assert(panel.Open() and not Controls.Panel:IsHidden(),'human native scatter choice panel did not open')
local first=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_AbsorptionFlow.GetPending(Game.GetLocalPlayer()))
assert(first.ID=='native-scatter-flow' and first.Phase=='CHOICE','wrong pending native scatter flow')
local sent={}
local function nextChoice()
 local flow=ExposedMembers.JAC_AbsorptionFlow.GetPending(Game.GetLocalPlayer())
 if not flow or flow.Phase~='CHOICE' then return end
 for _,entry in ipairs(flow.Entries or {}) do
  if not entry.EscapeOutcome and not entry.SelectedAction then
   if sent[entry.ID] then return end
   assert(panel.SelectEntry(entry.ID),'could not select '..entry.ID)
   local action=entry.Kind=='UNIT' and 'INCORPORATE'
     or entry.Kind=='PERSON' and 'RECRUIT'
     or entry.Kind=='HERO' and 'RECONTRACT'
     or entry.Kind=='GREAT_PERSON' and 'RECRUIT'
     or entry.Kind=='ITEM' and 'TRANSFER'
     or entry.Kind=='UNLOCK' and 'INHERIT' or 'PRESERVE'
   assert(panel.ChooseAction(action),'real UI rejected '..entry.ID..'/'..action)
   sent[entry.ID]=true
   return
  end
 end
end
Events.GameCoreEventPublishComplete.Add(nextChoice)
nextChoice()
return 'human native scatter selections started through the real panel'

local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local F=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlowGameplay)
local flow=assert(F.Get('native-scatter-flow'))
local baseline=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_SCATTER_FLOW'))
assert(flow.Phase=='CHOICE' and flow.Phase1Complete,'scatter choice phase changed before confirmation')
local n=0
for _,entry in ipairs(flow.Entries or {}) do
 if entry.ID=='native-work:'..baseline.WorkIndex then
  n=n+1
  assert(entry.EscapeOutcome=='SCATTER' and not entry.SelectedAction,'escaped original work was chosen again')
  assert(A.Rules.Equal(entry.Rolls,baseline.Rolls),'original work was rerolled')
 elseif not entry.EscapeOutcome then assert(entry.SelectedAction,'surviving asset lacks a UI choice') end
end
assert(n==1,'original work missing or duplicated in saved Flow')
assert(#A.NativeWorkLocations(baseline.WorkIndex)==1,'choice phase moved original work early')
return 'all surviving assets selected and scattered work roll unchanged'

local panel=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlow_UI)
local view=panel.GetView()
assert(view.phase=='CHOICE' and view.canResolve and not Controls.ConfirmButton:IsDisabled(),'scatter confirmation control not ready')
Controls.ConfirmButton:DoLeftClick()
return 'human clicked the real scatter Flow confirm control'

local id='native-scatter-flow'
local flow=ExposedMembers.JAC_AbsorptionFlow and ExposedMembers.JAC_AbsorptionFlow.Get(id)
local state=ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption and ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption.GetState()
local tx=state and state.Transactions[id]
if not flow then return false end
if flow.Phase=='BLOCKED' or flow.Phase=='RESULT' then return true end
if not tx then return false end
if tx.NativeDealUI and tx.NativeDealUI.Index==2 then return true end
for _,work in ipairs(tx.NativeWorks or {}) do if work.Source.Index==2 and work.PhysicalMoved then return true end end
return false

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local F=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlowGameplay)
local baseline=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_SCATTER_FLOW'))
local flow=assert(F.Get(baseline.ID))
assert(flow.Phase~='BLOCKED','scatter Flow blocked before native deal: '..tostring(flow.Error))
local tx=assert(A.GetState().Transactions[baseline.ID],'scatter product transaction absent')
local snap
for _,work in ipairs(tx.NativeWorks or {}) do if work.Source.Index==baseline.WorkIndex then snap=work;break end end
assert(snap and snap.Outcome=='SCATTER' and snap.Custodian==baseline.Free and snap.DealSubmitted,'scatter native deal intent was not saved')
local slot=snap.TargetSlot
assert(slot and slot.Owner==baseline.FreeSlot.Owner and slot.City==baseline.FreeSlot.City
 and slot.X==baseline.FreeSlot.X and slot.Y==baseline.FreeSlot.Y
 and slot.Building==baseline.FreeSlot.Building and slot.Slot==baseline.FreeSlot.Slot,'scatter deal reserved the wrong Free Cities official slot')
if not snap.PhysicalMoved then
 assert(tx.NativeDealUI and tx.NativeDealUI.Index==baseline.WorkIndex,'scatter UI publication token absent')
 for _,city in ipairs(tx.Cities or {}) do assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(city.X,city.Y):GetOwner()==baseline.From,'AI donor city changed before original work proof') end
 print('[JAC_NATIVE_SCATTER_DEAL_INTENT] index='..snap.Source.Index..' token='..tx.NativeDealUI.Token..' target='..slot.Owner..':'..slot.City..':'..slot.Building..':'..slot.Slot)
else
 print('[JAC_NATIVE_SCATTER_DEAL_RECONCILED] index='..snap.Source.Index..' status='..tx.Status..' phase='..flow.Phase)
end
return 'product Flow saved the native scatter deal; physical custody is a separate gate'
